preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each non-empty line in stdin contains exactly one token (either an integer T or a string s).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) if (s := stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else True
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of lowercase English letters ('a' through 'z').

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10**5 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if (s := stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else True
preconditions.description: The length n of each string s satisfies 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if (s := stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else True
preconditions.description: Each string s contains only lowercase letters (no uppercase or other characters).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(1 <= int(p) <= len(s) for p in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == len(s))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if no valid permutation exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout contains exactly n space-separated integers P₁, P₂, ..., Pₙ, where each Pᵢ is a unique integer between 1 and n (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '-1') and (all(s[int(p)-1] == s[int(q)-1] for i, (p, q) in enumerate(zip(stdout.split(), reversed(stdout.split()))))) if (s := stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else True
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation P applied to s produces a palindromic string t, meaning t[i] == t[n+1-i] for all 1 ≤ i ≤ n (1-based indexing).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '-1') and (len(set(stdout.split())) == len(s)) if (s := stdin.splitlines()[1:]) else True
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', the permutation P is a valid permutation of numbers 1 through n (i.e., all Pᵢ are distinct and cover 1..n).
